global_prompt: A photorealistic cinematic family scene set in a cozy suburban home on a sunny morning, captured in one continuous handheld tracking shot without cuts.
local_prompts: The camera follows a golden retriever approaching a busy breakfast table.
The dog stands on its hind legs, placing its front paws against the edge of the table next to a young schoolboy.
The boy gets up from the breakfast table, and the camera follows him as he picks up his school backpack.
The camera tracks the boy as he runs toward a waiting yellow school bus.
The camera turns around to reveal the golden retriever standing sadly in the front doorway, watching the school bus drive away.
